capabilities: translate selected code blocks into simple English
guess the language a code block is written in
run the translation from a ribbon icon
extras: The README references a gif demo that is not included in the provided text; setup requires pasting an API key in the plugin settings.
motivation: Built for Obsidian October 2021; no other motivation is stated.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get plain-English explanations of code blocks inside notes.
summary: AI plugin that translates selected code blocks into plain English and guesses the language via the Stenography API.
